title: Tamozawa Imperial Villa

terrainReference.basis: Original GSI grade at the northeastern approach to the villa.

mapIdentity.scope: The named 74-point OSM roof-scale outline and the 16 holes determine connected villa extent, courtyard count and approximate eave limits. The native relation’s annex identity tag disagrees with the visible standing building and is preserved as source metadata only.

note: Two exact 2018 photos support blue-gray copper roof planes, dark timber verandahs and stepped roof heights. The prefectural record confirms timber single-story wings, two- and three-story parts and copper shingle roofs.
